title: The Hidden Impact of Water Pipe Diameter
description: Have you ever noticed your shower pressure drop when someone turns on the kitchen faucet? Often, the issue comes down to pipe sizing. Pipes that are too small restrict water flow, leading to annoying pressure drops throughout your home. On the other hand, pipes that are oversized can cause water to move too slowly, which affects system efficiency and increases installation costs unnecessarily. Proper sizing ensures balanced water pressure, quiet pipe operation, and optimal fixture performance. If you are planning a renovation or noticing persistent water pressure changes, schedule a consultation with a licensed plumber to evaluate your home's system.
